description: Fetch a Vimeo video's full metadata from its watch page (vimeo.com/{id}): title, description, duration, dimensions, upload time, privacy level, thumbnails, and uploader, plus exact views/likes. --include-transcript returns the subtitles/transcript when the video provides one (not all do). --include-comments fetches the comment thread (comments are uploader-enabled — when a video has comments off, the command returns an empty list with commentsDisabled=true). Comment ordering maps to the page's sort dropdown (default newest). Requires a browser session; public videos need no login.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Video URL (https://vimeo.com/1188438376) or just the numeric ID. Channel-context URLs (vimeo.com/channels/staffpicks/{id}) are also accepted — the canonical video page is resolved automatically. URLs come from vimeo/search, get-category, get-channel, get-trending, or get-user results.

parameters.name: include_transcript
parameters.description: Set to true to also return the video's transcript/subtitles when available. Default false.

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: Set to true to also fetch the comment thread under the video. Comments are enabled per-video by the uploader; videos without comments return an empty list with commentsDisabled=true. Default false.

parameters.name: comment_limit
parameters.description: Maximum comments to return (1-100, default 20). Only used when include_comments is true; partial=true when the thread is exhausted.

parameters.name: comment_sort
parameters.description: Comment ordering matching the page's sort dropdown: newest (default) | oldest.
